title: Plan minimal Pi telemetry release for the existing local pipeline
description: Review the existing plan against the owner-provided Claude collector/viewer setup. Make traces a current-release requirement, minimize scope, and create actionable dependency-ordered implementation and approval-gated verification beads. Do not implement or touch the real pipeline.
close_reason: Reviewed shared-pipeline scope, revised plan to require current-release traces and assistant-only accounting, and created an epic with eight dependency-ordered tasks including a separate live approval gate.

title: Release metadata-only Pi logs, metrics and traces to the existing local pipeline
description:
Outcome: explicitly enabled Pi instrumentation exports OTLP/gRPC to the existing localhost:4317 collector, which already forwards to otel-desktop-viewer/DuckDB. All three signals, including traces, are required this release. Keep assistant-only usage accounting honest; no comprehensive nested-model/compaction/summary spending, content capture, new infrastructure or Claude parity. Follow .agents/plans/20261030T103922--implement-opentelemetry-extension__inprogress/plan.md. Implementation readiness and owner-approved live persistence are separate milestones. Do not touch owner services/configuration or emit real records without approval.

## Success Criteria
All implementation tasks complete with current-release traces, decoded real-SDK evidence, safe bounded operation, clean tarball loading, and explicit assistant-only accounting. Live persistence is separately approved and verified before claiming rollout complete.

title: 1. Verify current Pi and OTel contracts for the minimal release
description:
Plan: .agents/plans/20261030T103922--implement-opentelemetry-extension__inprogress/plan.md

Read current installed Pi docs, exported types, SDK examples and relevant source. Pin compatible Node/Pi/OTel versions with pnpm@12.15.0. Write docs/contracts.md with source citations, a startup/new/resume/fork/reload/shutdown transition table, finalized-assistant usage/cost boundary, actual request model/provider identity, tool IDs/parents and timing. Verify private OTel provider/exporter options, environment isolation including headers/resources, delta temporality, bounds and real cleanup. Establish the smallest deterministic real-SDK fake-provider approach. Do not investigate complete compaction/nested spending or private transcript scanning.

Follow test-audit when writing/reviewing tests. Keep each coherent task in its own jj change; run real Make gates at task boundaries and record results.

## Acceptance Criteria
Contract note cites versioned source, distinguishes assistant lifecycle from HTTP retries, defines accounting exclusions, and confirms a feasible clean-shutdown strategy. Stop for owner decision if a required public SDK boundary is unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: Contract note cites versioned source, distinguishes assistant lifecycle from HTTP retries, defines accounting exclusions, and confirms a feasible clean-shutdown strategy. Stop for owner decision if a required public SDK boundary is unavailable.
notes: Owner approved the recommended fail-closed policy in this conversation: disable Pi telemetry with a safe diagnostic if inherited general or per-signal OTLP header settings are present. Resume discovery and then implement uf4.2–uf4.7 in order using official signal exporters. This approval does not authorize live-pipeline exports, paid calls, permanent/global installation or publication.

title: 2. Scaffold the pnpm Pi package and disabled-safe configuration
description:
Plan: .agents/plans/20261030T103922--implement-opentelemetry-extension__inprogress/plan.md

Use the plan's preserved pi-exa/pi-btw scaffold: ESM TypeScript source entry, peer-plus-pinned-dev Pi dependencies, ordinary OTel runtime dependencies, pinned pnpm/lockfile, Biome, strict TS, Knip, Make and distinct nonempty unit/integration Vitest suites. Inspect local sibling configs when available. Register handlers and /otel-status without providers in the factory. Implement explicit master/trace booleans and local-only shared gRPC destination validation. Reject unsafe config safely. Disabled/no-session load must not create telemetry sockets/timers or enable itself from Claude flags. Add the isolated Pi loader smoke test; do not rely on global config.

Follow test-audit when writing/reviewing tests. Keep each coherent task in its own jj change; run real Make gates at task boundaries and record results.

## Acceptance Criteria
make format, make check, make test pass for this slice; installed Pi loads the extension with clean stdout. Invalid/disabled configuration cannot send traffic or disclose a rejected URL. No infrastructure changes.
acceptance_criteria: make format, make check, make test pass for this slice; installed Pi loads the extension with clean stdout. Invalid/disabled configuration cannot send traffic or disclose a rejected URL. No infrastructure changes.
notes: Owner installed dependencies and removed package-mutation restriction; resume implementation. Preserve owner package.json/pnpm-lock.yaml changes and actual project packageManager pin. Prior fail-closed inherited OTLP header approval remains in force. Live pipeline/public distribution still separately gated.
close_reason: Disabled-safe config and real offline Pi loader pass Make format/check/test; owner pnpm 12.16.1 scaffold/lock preserved. Temporary future-slice dependency ignores removed as consumed.

title: 3. Export the first real assistant session to decoded OTLP logs and metrics
description:
Plan: .agents/plans/20261030T103922--implement-opentelemetry-extension__inprogress/plan.md

Build the smallest official-SDK private log/metric runtime at verified activation and dispose idempotently. Emit session events/count and finalized assistant events plus finite nonnegative assistant token/estimated-cost counters with actual session/run/request IDs and per-message provider/model. Usage on unsuccessful messages is retained; missing cost is not zero. Use explicit delta temporality and exporter destination/header/resource isolation. Create one shared real Pi SDK fake-provider and maintained-protobuf loopback receiver harness. No custom encoders, global providers, history reconciliation or awaited event-handler exports. Include basic queue/timeouts and clean short-run shutdown now.

Follow test-audit when writing/reviewing tests. Keep each coherent task in its own jj change; run real Make gates at task boundaries and record results.

## Acceptance Criteria
A deterministic public SDK session produces correctly decoded known usage/events and cleanly exits without a forced kill; two collection intervals do not repeat usage. Model switching preserves attribution. README states assistant-only spending exclusions. Private fake-handler calls alone are insufficient.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic public SDK session produces correctly decoded known usage/events and cleanly exits without a forced kill; two collection intervals do not repeat usage. Model switching preserves attribution. README states assistant-only spending exclusions. Private fake-handler calls alone are insufficient.

title: 4. Record run and concurrent/nested tool lifecycles accurately
description:
Plan: .agents/plans/20261030T103922--implement-opentelemetry-extension__inprogress/plan.md

Add run start/end events, completed-run counts/durations, tool result events and tool counts/durations using verified actual Pi lifecycle. Correlate real IDs, support parallel/nested calls where public parent IDs exist, and use monotonic duration measurement. Missing starts/ends are incomplete rather than fabricated success/zero duration; shutdown never duplicates success. Do not sum reported inclusive tool/nested-model spending into assistant usage. Run elapsed time may include uninstrumented compaction and is not human active time.

Follow test-audit when writing/reviewing tests. Keep each coherent task in its own jj change; run real Make gates at task boundaries and record results.

## Acceptance Criteria
Real-SDK decoded export tests cover multi-turn runs, successful/failed/aborted tools, parallel overlapping tools and nested parents where supported. Every actual observed execution counts once, outcomes are honest, and accounting totals are unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Real-SDK decoded export tests cover multi-turn runs, successful/failed/aborted tools, parallel overlapping tools and nested parents where supported. Every actual observed execution counts once, outcomes are honest, and accounting totals are unchanged.

title: 5. Implement current-release run/request/tool traces and correlated logs
description:
Plan: .agents/plans/20261030T103922--implement-opentelemetry-extension__inprogress/plan.md

Add official private tracer provider behind PI_OTEL_TRACES while master opt-in remains required. Run spans are roots; assistant requests and tools are children, nested tools use real parent IDs. No session-long root, duplicate tool spans, global context manager, retry-span claims or child-process instrumentation. Use explicit parent/log contexts and a small verified GenAI convention subset. Preserve parallel timings, actual per-request model identity, normalized error/abort/incomplete outcomes and bounded cleanup.

Follow test-audit when writing/reviewing tests. Keep each coherent task in its own jj change; run real Make gates at task boundaries and record results.

## Acceptance Criteria
Decoded real-SDK trace tree has correct parents, timing relationships and outcomes; exported log trace/span IDs match corresponding spans. Missing optional provider hooks retain supported observations. Toggle-off retains local correlation and identical usage metrics. Traces are implemented before the release is considered ready.
acceptance_criteria: Decoded real-SDK trace tree has correct parents, timing relationships and outcomes; exported log trace/span IDs match corresponding spans. Missing optional provider hooks retain supported observations. Toggle-off retains local correlation and identical usage metrics. Traces are implemented before the release is considered ready.

title: 6. Prove failure isolation, privacy, bounded state and lifecycle replacement
description:
Plan: .agents/plans/20261030T103922--implement-opentelemetry-extension__inprogress/plan.md

Complete shared per-signal export status and bounded lifecycle: disabled/unverified/healthy/degraded, safe per-signal last result, defined recovery/sticky loss, rate-limited stderr/UI only. Verify <=512 queued logs/spans, <=128 batches, approx 1s exporter deadlines and aggregate <=1.5s awaited shutdown with scheduler slack; ensure underlying timers/sockets/retries also end. Bound open state to 1024/kind and metric cardinality/attribute size with explicit overflow semantics. Exercise supported new/resume/fork/reload transitions without historical replay or stale IDs. Reuse the real-SDK/decoded-wire harness rather than adding test-only production abstractions.

Follow test-audit when writing/reviewing tests. Keep each coherent task in its own jj change; run real Make gates at task boundaries and record results.

## Acceptance Criteria
Default gates prove refused/hung collectors do not block next operations or clean child exit; outage/load stays bounded; transitions do not leak/replay. Sentinels in prompts, thinking, results, args and errors never appear in any decoded signal or diagnostics, even with inherited content flags. Hostile inherited endpoints/headers/resources cannot bypass policy. Forced cleanup kills fail exit assertions.

title: 7. Document and validate the packed release with the same quality gates
description:
Plan: .agents/plans/20261030T103922--implement-opentelemetry-extension__inprogress/plan.md

Finish README/CHANGELOG and owner-approved license before distribution: install and temporary env PI_OTEL_ENABLED=1 PI_OTEL_TRACES=1 activation against inherited localhost:4317, exact supported/ignored config, delta signals, assistant-only spending exclusions, trace semantics, status, privacy/loss and disable instructions that leave Claude unaffected. Add minimal pinned Node/pnpm CI running frozen install and existing Make gates, no release platform/matrix. pnpm pack, inspect shipped files and load/install tarball in an isolated pnpm project/Pi environment. No global installation/publication.

Follow test-audit when writing/reviewing tests. Keep each coherent task in its own jj change; run real Make gates at task boundaries and record results.

## Acceptance Criteria
make format/check/test pass in order; frozen install and packed extension work under pnpm isolated layout. Package excludes tests, plans, credentials/settings. All three signals are complete; report implementation-ready status separately from live-verified.

title: 8. Approval gate: verify all three Pi signals persist in the existing viewer
description:
Plan: .agents/plans/20261030T103922--implement-opentelemetry-extension__inprogress/plan.md

STOP and ask before sending any data to the owner's real collector/database. Ask separately before paid calls, persistent/global installation or config/service changes. Once approved, inspect actual collector config/running viewer read-only and use viewer query help/schema/API (never independently open active DuckDB). Baseline counts, run a bounded explicitly enabled session with traces, and query only its IDs/new interval. Verify pi-coding-agent alongside claude-code, known assistant usage, tool records, spans and matching log trace/span IDs. Prefer a fake provider to avoid paid calls if feasible; approval still required for database writes. Do not recreate services.

Follow test-audit when writing/reviewing tests. Keep each coherent task in its own jj change; run real Make gates at task boundaries and record results.

## Acceptance Criteria
Record explicit approval and evidence that logs, delta metrics and correlated traces persisted in the existing viewer, not just exporter acknowledgements. Report any changes separately; permanent installation remains a separate decision.
